description: We are Spectra, building a wearable gadget with multispectral sensors to monitor astronaut health. Our idea combines onboard microcontrollers, machine learning and a dashboard to detect unusual patterns and relay alerts to Earth. Interested in space, health, or hands-on innovation? Join us! We're looking for teammates with skills in embedded systems, sensors, ML, software development, UI/UX, biomedical science and storytelling
